title: Analysis: institutional investors are selling stakes in older VC funds from the 2021 investment boom peak at steep discounts and rushing to back new AI funds (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Analysis: institutional investors are selling stakes in older VC funds from the 2021 investment boom peak at steep discounts and rushing to back new AI funds — Pension funds and endowments ditch legacy stakes at knockdown prices to free up cash for next-generation tech start-ups
